bitcoin_articles.headline: Fold Holdings Sells Bitcoin to Repay Debt
bitcoin_articles.summary: Fold Holdings, Inc. has sold 633.8 BTC to repay $20 million in debt, leaving the company with a remaining balance of 192.2 BTC.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BitGo Launches 'Lightning Earn' for Institutional Bitcoin Deployment
bitcoin_articles.summary: BitGo Bank & Trust has introduced 'Lightning Earn,' a service allowing institutional clients to deploy bitcoin on the Lightning Network via an integration with Amboss Technologies.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock Files Form 8-A for iShares Bitcoin Premium Income ETF
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock has filed a Form 8-A registration document for its upcoming iShares Bitcoin Premium Income ETF, a procedural step typically preceding a fund's market debut.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Nakamoto Inc. Sells 600 BTC in Major Bitcoin Treasury Deleveraging
bitcoin_articles.summary: Nakamoto Inc. has executed a sale of 600 Bitcoin as part of a treasury deleveraging initiative.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Sterling Digital Plc Commences Site Installation for West Texas Bitcoin Mining Operations
bitcoin_articles.summary: Sterling Digital Plc has begun on-site installation works at its West Texas facility, transitioning from the planning phase to active infrastructure deployment for its Bitcoin mining operations.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Canaan Inc. Reports May 2026 Bitcoin Mining and Operational Updates
bitcoin_articles.summary: Canaan Inc. released its unaudited mining data for May 2026, reporting 90 BTC produced from self-mining and a record cryptocurrency treasury of 1,867 BTC and 3,952 ETH.
